## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation (e.g. "It's difficult to configure batch duplex printing when...").

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how it should integrate into Odyssey's architecture.

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Subsystem Impact
- [ ] Frontend Client (React 19 / State / UI)
- [ ] WebGL & Graphics (Three.js Cursor / SVG Landscapes)
- [ ] Audio Pipeline (Web Audio API Soundscapes)
- [ ] Backend & API (Express Gateway / Mongoose Schemas)
- [ ] Print & Receipt Engine (Thermal Formatter / PDF Ingestion)

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup references, or technical specifications here.
